claims.claim: UK used Canon EOS 600D Digital Camera very neat and sharp.
claims.evidence: Photos show the camera and lenses, but do not prove origin (UK) or image sharpness/neatness in real use.

risks.risk: Wrong item / mixed listing: photos include both EOS 600D and EOS 700D, so it’s unclear which exact body you will receive.
risks.proof: Ask for a single photo of the exact camera you’re buying with the screen on showing the model (or a close-up of the “EOS 600D” label) and the same serial number/box if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case mismatch risk: treat as not guaranteed to be EOS 600D only.

risks.risk: Lens condition and functionality not shown (focus, zoom smoothness, fungus/haze, scratches).
risks.proof: Request a short video of lens focus (half-press shutter) and zoom from wide to tele, plus a close-up of front and rear lens elements under light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lenses may need cleaning/repair or have reduced performance.

risks.risk: Camera shutter count, sensor health, and whether it fully works (AF, buttons, ports) are not shown.
risks.proof: Request a photo of the camera powered on showing menu screen + a test shot (JPEG) and a screen showing shutter count (if they can).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven working; assume typical used wear.

risks.risk: Accessories/charger/battery/SD card not confirmed in photos.
risks.proof: Ask for a laid-out photo showing every included item: battery, charger, USB cable, strap, lens caps, and any memory card.
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing some accessories (worst-case: only body + lens).

proof_requests: Confirm which exact body you will receive: EOS 600D only (not EOS 700D). Send one clear close-up of the “EOS 600D” label on the exact unit.
Show included accessories in one photo (battery, charger, caps, strap, SD card if any).
Send a short video: autofocus test + zoom in/out on the EFS 18-55mm lens.
Send close-ups of both front and rear lens elements (front glass and rear glass) under light to check fungus/haze/scratches.
Send a powered-on menu photo and one sample image (JPEG) taken in daylight.
response.reason: The photos clearly show a Canon EOS 600D, but the set also includes an EOS 700D in photo 2, and key proof for what you’ll actually receive (exact body + accessories + full functionality) is missing. Without that, a safe price cannot be chosen confidently.
